name: Keisei-Ueno
tagline: Tokyo in 22 minutes and Otemachi in 28 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Taito City, where Keisei run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 28 minutes to Otemachi, 36 minutes to Shinjuku, 41 minutes to Shibuya and 36 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 9.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 14.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 9.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.4 m to 16.6 m, a difference of 14.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 2 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 64 clinics and 49 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is アイシークリニック上野院, about 7 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 全仁会上野病院, about 9 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Keisei Main Line and Narita Sky Access Line. Both lines are run by Keisei, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Keisei Main Line runs at 137% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大神宮下→京成船橋, which this station is not on. Narita Sky Access Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000, 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000, 1LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000 and 2LDK ¥260,000 to ¥270,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Ueno is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is, but Keisei-Ueno is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi 17 minutes sooner than Keisei-Ueno.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Keisei-Ueno, but Okachimachi is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi 15 minutes sooner than Keisei-Ueno. One-room rents run about ¥21,000 higher.

goodFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: The 首都高速1号上野線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
中央通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 25 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
